mode.title: Mode
mode.description: prices = the latest published week for every region, with the move on the week and year and the spread against the national average. history = one row per region per week. series = what regions and grades are published.

product.title: Fuel
product.description: Petrol (gasoline) or diesel. Diesel has no formulation split.

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: Gasoline: regular, midgrade, premium or all. Diesel: no2, low_sulfur, ultra_low_sulfur.

formulation.title: Formulation
formulation.description: Gasoline only. conventional, reformulated, or all for both combined.

regions.title: Regions (optional)
regions.description: Filter by name, for example California, Gulf Coast, Chicago. Partial names match. Empty returns every region published.

areaTypes.title: Area types (optional)
areaTypes.description: national, region (the refining districts), state, city. Empty returns all of them.

weeksBack.title: Weeks of history
weeksBack.description: History mode. How many weeks back from the latest published week.

startDate.title: Start date (optional)
startDate.description: History mode. YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides weeks of history.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
